headline: Is my soulmate closer than I think?
note: generated from REVIEW-new-voice.md — not a wired draft

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing marked the backs, and you took the one with nothing put away.
Look at his table. It's all out, and all of it within arm's reach.
You asked if your soulmate is closer than you think. What catches me is that nothing on that table had to be fetched.
And yet nobody has come. And you're the one asking how close it is.
Something stands in between, close in rather than far off. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's there…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The backs gave nothing away, and you found the calmest man in the deck.
He hangs by one ankle. Look at his face, though — it's calm.
You asked if your soulmate is closer than you think. What holds my eye is how little is moving in this picture.
Still, nobody has come. And the whole question you brought is how close it is.
The hold is quiet, and it doesn't strain. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's doing that…
c: You turned the Fool. You couldn't see a face, and yours was the one in full sun.
Look at the sky. It's gold, and there's not one cloud in it.
You asked if your soulmate is closer than you think. A bright day, and the walking started.
But nobody has come. And you're still the one asking how far off it is.
Something turns up at the point where it would show. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's behind this…
